text: Leading a healthy life involves more than just eating well. A balanced diet, rich in fruits and vegetables, gives your body the energy it needs, while regular exercise keeps your heart strong and your mind clear. Equally important is sleep, which allows your body to repair itself and helps you focus during the day. Don’t forget mental health, either—taking time to relax and manage stress is essential. Finally, a healthy work-life balance means setting boundaries between your job and personal time, so you can enjoy hobbies and spend time with loved ones without feeling guilty. Small daily habits create lasting well-being.
